create.name: Centre de Yoga Iyengar de Montréal
create.bio:
The Centre de Yoga Iyengar de Montréal is a French-speaking Iyengar studio on Rue Clark in the Plateau Mont-Royal, founded in 1989 by Marie-Andrée Morin. It is now run by two of her former students, Claudie Berge and Marie-Chantal Perras, who co-own it, and a team of nine certified teachers who belong to the Iyengar Yoga Association of Canada. Claudie, certified at Level 2 and authorised to mentor new teachers, has studied in Pune with Prashant and Geeta Iyengar.

The centre's bright, wood-floored room of about 900 square feet is fitted with ropes, chairs, blankets and blocks. Teaching follows the syllabus set in Pune, moving from a beginners' Level 1 class through combined multi-level groups, with classes of seventy-five minutes to two hours that close with relaxation, and quieter sessions using ropes and chairs. Regular online classes, including an early Friday practice, are taught over Zoom, and private one-to-one lessons can be arranged. For students who have practised the method for at least three years, the centre offers a three-year mentoring programme towards certification, combining observation and practice with study of anatomy and readings in Indian philosophy, with the final assessment validated by senior Canadian teachers.

courses.title: Programme de formation (Mentorat)
courses.description: A three-year mentoring programme for students with at least three consecutive years of Iyengar practice, guided by a designated certified teacher. Study through practice, observation and classes is supported by anatomy and suggested reading in Indian philosophy, and the final assessment is validated by senior teachers of the Canadian association.

courses.title: Cours réguliers au Centre
courses.description: Weekly in-studio classes taught in sequence from a beginners' Level 1 to multi-level groups, following the posture syllabus from Pune. Each class lasts between 75 minutes and two hours and ends with relaxation; new students can join at any time.

courses.title: Cartes de cours illimités
courses.description: Unlimited monthly or three-month class cards for in-studio classes, with introductory cards for new students and class-pack cards for occasional attendance. A trial class is available for the Level 1 groups.
courses.price: Carte Mauve – 115.00$ +tx (1 mois); Carte Orange – 85.00$ +tx (nouveaux élèves)

courses.title: Cours en ligne
courses.description: Live online classes over Zoom, booked and paid for individually through the centre's online calendar.
